title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research

claim.summary: TSFLab is an agent-agnostic workbench for time series forecasting research: compatible coding agents share a forecasting research guide, layered knowledge cards for 323 methods, 93 datasets and 71 reusable units, a declarative experiment runner under shared protocols, and a recursive improver that verifies and merges new resources.

modules.name: Agent-agnostic research workbench
modules.scope_reason: Shared resources and tools are placed outside the agent and exposed to any compatible coding agent without altering it; the mechanism does not depend on temporal semantics or on a task objective.

modules.name: Forecasting research guide with task-specific skills
modules.scope_reason: Entry instructions and skills encode forecasting workflows, evaluation settings, and pitfalls such as the forecast target and metric choice, so the guidance is bound to the forecasting task contract.

modules.name: Layered knowledge cards and shared model units
modules.scope_reason: Method and unit cards describe forecasting models, their configurations, and reusable forecasting blocks such as RevIN, so the knowledge structure is organized around forecasting methods.

modules.name: Shared temporal data registration and leakage-safe splitting
modules.scope_reason: Dataset cards and shared routines record time fields, sampling frequency, splits, and scaling, and fit scaling on training data only; these temporal data operations are reusable beyond one forecasting method.

modules.name: Declarative experiment runner under shared protocols
modules.scope_reason: Agents declare experiments with lookback, horizon, and training budget, and results are compared only under the same forecasting protocol, which binds the runner to the forecasting evaluation contract.
